title: The Bellwether Test Case
subtitle: A small technical rehearsal in Bellwether, Iowa

investigators.name: Mara Voss
investigators.description: A patient interviewer with old ties to Bellwether County.

investigators.name: Elias Reed
investigators.description: A methodical scene reader who notices what people try to clean away.

locations.name: Sheriff's Annex
locations.description: A cramped brick annex that smells of radiator dust and burnt coffee.

images.label: Exterior
images.alt: The Sheriff's Annex on a wet Bellwether street at dusk.

images.label: Records office
images.alt: A cramped records office with worn desks, filing cabinets, and burnt coffee.

locations.name: Ruth's Diner
locations.description: A chrome-sided diner where the pie case glows long after the rest of town sleeps.

images.label: Exterior
images.alt: An isolated chrome diner glowing beside a wet county road at night.

images.label: Dining room
images.alt: The diner's worn counter, pie case, red stools, and shadowed booths.

locations.name: Harker Grain Elevator
locations.description: The elevator's concrete silos loom above the cornfields like pale, windowless towers.

images.label: Exterior
images.alt: The Harker Grain Elevator looming above harvested fields after sunset.

images.label: Machinery floor
images.alt: The dark machinery floor and open cylindrical grain dryer.

locations.name: St. Orison's Chapel
locations.description: A black-steepled chapel surrounded by leaning stones and wind-flattened grass.

images.label: Exterior
images.alt: St. Orison's Chapel beyond leaning cemetery stones at nightfall.

images.label: Nave
images.alt: The chapel nave with old pews, candles, bell rope, and dark stained glass.

locations.name: North Star Motor Court
locations.description: Eight motel rooms curl around an empty pool full of rainwater and dead leaves.

images.label: Exterior
images.alt: The North Star Motor Court surrounding its rain-filled abandoned pool.

images.label: Room 6
images.alt: A decaying motel room lit by a bedside lamp and cold neon through blinds.
